news.analysis: Cousins had a nice return to the Vikings in Week 10. He followed up with a tough game in Week 11. The veteran QB was fairly efficient with his passing, but he failed to find the end zone, unless the pick-six he threw late in the second quarter counts. Joking aside, Cousins will have better games, and a matchup with one of his former teams - the Falcons - awaits in Week 12. Cousins is right on the fringe of QB1 status in standard formats.
news.contents: Kirk Cousins completed 26-of-38 passes for 235 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

news.analysis: Gibbs continues a dynamic stretch out of the Detroit backfield, recording one or more touchdowns in nine of 10 games. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats entering a Week 12 matchup against the Chicago Bears.

The Buccaneers had allowed just three rushing touchdowns all season entering Sunday and kept Gibbs out of the end zone until the fourth quarter. news.analysis: Cook put together another steady day of production as he has done every week this season. He remains a steady RB1 for fantasy managers.
news.contents: James Cook III ran for 89 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for three yards receiving.
news.title: James Cook III finds the end zone Sunday

news.contents: Going up against a depleted Miami Dolphins defensive line, Buffalo Bills running back James Cook III could feast in Week 11. The Dolphins have lost their top three defensive linemen due to injury over the past two weeks, which points to Cook delivering another solid performance. Cook is coming off a 157-yard performance against the Jets last week, during which he found the end zone for the eighth straight game. news.analysis: Washington had a ridiculous 17 targets on Sunday, by far the most he's seen in a game this year. He had a controversial play late in the game where he bobbled a potential touchdown, appeared to secure it and get his feet in bounds, but was ruled incomplete because Washington had not yet completed possession. It's a tough break for the breakout receiver, but he's now had back-to-back 100-yard games and gets the Titans next week.

This was Hockenson's first game back with veteran QB Kirk Cousins leading the Minnesota offense. Hockenson could be set for a productive stretch run.

news.contents: Micah Parsons (knee) has been cleared to return for the Green Bay Packers Monday according to Ian Rapoport.
news.title: Micah Parsons (knee) cleared to return Monday

news.contents: Green Bay Packers star pass-rusher Micah Parsons (knee) has been cleared and is set for his season debut against the Los Angeles Rams on Wednesday, sources told Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. After tearing his ACL and meniscus on Dec. 14 of last year against the Denver Broncos, Parsons has checked every box and will be available in Week 12. The 27-year-old former 12th overall pick by the Dallas Cowboys out of Penn State will be officially activated from the Physically Unable to Perform list ...

news.analysis: Herbert tossed a pair of touchdowns to Ladd McConkey while adding a 10-yard rushing touchdown in the close loss. He suffered a concussion late in the game and entered the league's concussion protocol after the contest ended. He is unlikely to play in Week 12 vs. the Patriots, putting DJ Uiagalelei in line to make the start. Uiagalelei has completed two of his seven pass attempts this season for 24 yards and a touchdown. Stay tuned to the Chargers' practice reports this week.
news.contents: Justin Herbert completed 15 of his 21 passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns while adding eight rushes for 32 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.title: Justin Herbert throws two TDs, suffers concussion late in Week 11 loss

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol, according to Noah Furtado. Herbert played through the Chargers' final offensive snap in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the New York Jets, hitting Ladd McConkey for a six-yard touchdown with 2:01 left. He completed 15 of 21 passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns with no interceptions and added 32 yards and a touchdown on eight carries. The Chargers host the New England Patriots on Nov. 29. news.title: Justin Herbert in the Concussion Protocol

The 29-year-old hauled in seven of his eight targets for 55 yards in the win over the Miami Dolphins. news.contents: The National Football League is not suspending Pittsburgh Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf for trying to poke Philadelphia Eagles cornerback Cooper DeJean in the eye on Sunday, sources told Adam Schefter of ESPN.
